title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Anbu worries over Kanmani's divorce demand while buying baby items. He plots to oust Vennila, but a heartbroken Vennila shocks Rajeshwari by planning Kanmani's murder.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Ilamathi vows to transform Paraman into a devoted husband, while Viji senses her lost son's presence at the temple. Later, Ilamathi uncovers clues that link Paraman to Anand.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Vetri regrets missing Sudar's love for 10 years. Resolved to arrest Karna for Parvathy's murder, he gathers evidence with Prabhakaran, putting Karna and Divakar on guard.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Mayandi faces public humiliation as villagers spread false rumours about his and Meenatchi's arrests. Soon, Poongodi publicly defends his family and condemns the villagers.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Malar is delighted when Bagyaraj offers his support in finding a suitable bride for her brother. Elsewhere, Suresh faces difficulties while taking Mathi to her interview venue.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Seeing Thangamayil at home, Saravanan erupts in anger and grows frustrated. Despite his strong objection, Pandian firmly insists that she stay there until her child is born.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Chandayatha finally gains her father's consent to marry Cheran, bringing happiness to the family. Joyful preparations kick off as guests arrive for the grand wedding.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: An accidental flour shower on Meena leads to a funny mix-up as Nachiyar mistakes her for an old friend. Sathya earnestly requests Muthu to attend his wedding reception.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Aishwarya panics when Thamarai reveals her mimicry talent to Mohana. Eshwari rejoices as Neethiman again offers to discreetly obtain Sethupathi's project details from his files.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: As Karthik and Kasthuri head out, Madhu vents to Sasha about Arjun. Later, Sankar meets Aadhavan at a boutique and, along with Karikalan, praises him for his responsible nature.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Murugan urges Indhira to find another job to stay out of trouble. Meanwhile, Lakshmi is stunned when she overhears their secret conversation about Indhira's bike taxi job.

title: Bigg Boss
episodeTitle: BBTam Day 4: New Entry and Leadership Crisis
description: Kitchen fights end in a captaincy shift, Muniyamma breaks down in jail, and a new commoner enters. Tensions peak in the democracy question hour as leader Shatiga gets targeted.
